correctness.rationale: The lower bound follows by quantifier-free symmetrization to the exact undirected-cycle theorem. The upper bound is obtained by checking that the published endpoint-coordinate response strategy uses signed offsets and therefore preserves directed successor when the cut paths are oriented consistently. Ranks one and two are verified directly. A separate exhaustive finite-game solver agrees in 220 cases.

evidence: Pichler 2011 explicitly says the composition lemma is analogous for directed or undirected cycles, but records only a weaker sufficient estimate.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A broader theorem covering the exact directed threshold was not found. The undirected exact theorem does not by itself imply the upper bound in the richer directed language; the orientation-preservation check is needed.

value.rationale: Directed cycles are a canonical finite-model-theory test family and models of a single cyclic successor. The exact cutoff replaces a standard but nonsharp 2^q sufficient estimate by a complete classification and isolates the substantive fact that adding orientation does not change the rank threshold.
